title: Academic Calendar
content: The SRM academic calendar is divided into two semesters: Odd Semester (July to December) and Even Semester (January to May). Registration for subjects and payment of tuition fees takes place at the start of each semester. Classes run for approximately 90 instructional days (15-18 weeks) per semester. Cycle Test 1 (Internal Assessment) is typically scheduled in the 5th week of the semester, and Cycle Test 2 in the 10th week. Model examinations are conducted in the 14th week, followed by laboratory exams. End Semester examinations (both theory and practical) start from late November (Odd Sem) and late April (Even Sem). National holidays, cultural festivals (like Milan and Aarush), and sports meet schedules are declared in the detailed calendar published at the beginning of each academic year.
